review_method: Source-order full read: Japanese semantic authority, pinned English handling/reason, Korean accuracy/naturalness/register/terminology/localization. 1200 directly reviewed accepted IDs, 83 EDIT and 1117 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. Official Korean surface terms and the pinned English patch localization strategy were used as consistency baselines. Candidate rows were directly reread through ID 450215 and checked against current Korean before materialization; only directly verified edits are counted as EDIT.
